note: Briefs, not questions: each asks for a profile of one subject, and the walk answers a brief by reading the subject's article, fanning its sections out to children and letting each child hop once (walk-8 onwards). 'facts' are topics a good profile touches, pipe-separated alternatives matched as substrings of the root finding (present), of its cited evidence (supported) and of anything read (read). They are checked against live Wikipedia (rubric-check, 2026-09-18) and 'where' says which sections hold each, so a topic that only a section or a hop holds is known to be one. Kind 'brief' also makes the runner grade the profile's shape (paragraphs, sentences, articles and sections read, hops cited) and give the closed-book column a profile prompt. Four fields on purpose: a person, a trade route, an instrument, a living system.

seeds.seed: Tell me about Alan Turing and elaborate on the impact of his work.
seeds.where: Alan Turing (24 sections): every topic is in the lead except turing-test (Early computers and the Turing test; Ratio Club). conviction and apology also in their own sections. 'Turing Award' is in no section of the article, so it is not a topic.

seeds.seed: Tell me about the Silk Road and elaborate on its influence.
seeds.where: Silk Road (22 sections): all in the lead except richthofen (Name and contested significance only). buddhism also in Transmission of Buddhism; plague in Mongol Empire and Decline; belt-and-road in the lead only.

seeds.seed: Tell me about the Hubble Space Telescope and what it has discovered.
seeds.where: Hubble Space Telescope (52 sections): all in the lead except deep-field (Frontier Fields program; Proposal process; Extending visible wavelength images). mirror also in Flawed mirror, Origin of the problem, Design of a solution; expansion in Age and expansion of the universe. 'exoplanet' is only in Successors, so it is not a topic.

seeds.seed: Describe the Great Barrier Reef and the threats it faces.
seeds.where: Great Barrier Reef (25 sections): all in the lead except cyclone (Environmental threats; Dugong hunting). Threats each have a section: Climate change, Pollution, Sediment runoff, Crown of thorns, Overfishing, Shipping.
